stem.text: P, Q and R represent three different structures of an element.

stem.alt: Structure P: layered hexagonal network of bonded atoms, layers joined by dashed lines (graphite-like).
stem.label: P

stem.alt: Structure Q: three-dimensional tetrahedral network of bonded atoms (diamond-like).
stem.label: Q

stem.alt: Structure R: closed cage of linked pentagonal and hexagonal rings (fullerene-like).
stem.label: R
